answer: The delta edge is logged both ways, so a closed ring of 43 clones produces a signature the vertex analysis flags immediately. An hostile operator must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the nebula settlement applies the void retroactively. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
